draft.heroMessage: Follow Your Path with Scott A Jacobs
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I’m Scott Jacobs, your dedicated Grand Rapids real estate advisor. Backed by a business background and focused negotiation skills, I bring clarity and confidence to your buying and selling journey.
draft.aboutParagraph: With a corporate career foundation and a personal commitment to service, I focus on your unique needs at every stage of your real estate experience. Whether investing, upgrading, or searching for your first home, I prioritize your goals and guide you skillfully from the first conversation to closing. My thorough market knowledge, responsive communication, and problem-solving mindset put you in the best position for informed decisions. Let’s work together to bring your real estate vision to life.
draft.conciergeLine: Have questions or want to chat? Let’s grab coffee and discuss the best strategy for your next move.
draft.contactLine: Call or email me directly at 616-481-2122 or scottaj0204@gmail.com — I look forward to helping you achieve your real estate goals.
draft.tone: Welcoming, professional, and locally knowledgeable with a personal touch.

websiteDesign.heroSubtitle: Whether it's finding your dream home or investment properties, I can help bring together the design, community, and lifestyle you're searching for. My corporate background and locally owned brokerage offer you the negotiating skills, financial experience and real estate services you can trust. ~Scott A Jacobs

EMAIL SCOTT
SATELLITE VIEW

GOOGLE MAP
Nature lovers and wildlife enthusiasts: the possibilities are endless! Are you looking for a peaceful destination without the city lights and traffic noise? This is where you can see all the stars and hear the surrounding sounds of nature.

This Central Michigan Lower Peninsula property features three homes on one of the largest tracts of land available for sale in Michigan. ''Hopkins Trophy Whitetail Ranch” is currently an active licensed deer ranch open to year-around hunting with five miles of 10' fencing and numerous deluxe deer blinds for you and your guests. And if desired, the property can be converted into a free-range private hunting and fishing camp for exclusive use for friends and family.

The terrain consists mostly of wooded high ground, with some open fields, food plots and a few sections of deep cover.
